scenes.visual: Extreme close-up shot of tired eyes reflected in a monitor screen showing rapidly scrolling candlestick charts. Subtle eye strain visible. Background blur of multiple monitor bezels. scenes.voiceover: You're watching RSI, MACD, volume spikes, economic calendars, Twitter feeds, and three different news sources... and you still feel unprepared.

scenes.visual: Close-up reaction shot of trader's face — eyes widen slightly as they focus on the organized dashboard. Tension releases from jaw. storyboards.voiceover_hook: Too many indicators. Too many opinions. Too many bad trades. There's a better way.
storyboards.cta: Cut through the noise — install now

scenes.visual: POV POV shot through trader's eyes rapidly scrolling through phone. Hand moves frantically — swipe, swipe, tap, scroll. TradingView app shows multiple indicators. Cut to Telegram with flashing messages. Cut to Twitter/X with rapid-fire opinions. Cut to Discord with chat scrolling. Cut to news site with breaking banner. Fast cuts, 1-2 seconds each. Frantic energy. Urgent electronic music beat. Phone screen brightness at max.
scenes.voiceover: Telegram channels. News sites. Discord groups. TradingView. You're checking them all... constantly.

scenes.visual: Rapid montage: Laptop screen with 15+ browser tabs all showing different analysis. Quick cut to smartwatch showing price alerts. Quick cut to second phone buzzing with notifications. Quick cut to laptop again. Split-screen in corner showing all devices at once — overwhelming visual of information coming from everywhere simultaneously. Shaky camera work emphasizing the frantic pace. Music intensifies.
scenes.voiceover: And somehow, after all that scrolling, you're still not sure what to do.

scenes.visual: Close-up of trader's face showing defeat — eyes half-closed, jaw tight. Suddenly SLAMS laptop shut. Hands fly up in 'I give up' gesture. Heavy exhale audible. Head drops forward. Phone lands on desk with a thud. Complete stillness. Music cuts to silence. Camera holds on the closed laptop for a beat of pure quiet. The weight of overload is visible.
scenes.voiceover: Information overload is silently killing your trading performance. You're exhausted, overtrading, and second-guessing every decision.

scenes.visual: ABRUPT CUT TO BLACK. Complete silence. One beat of nothing. Then a soft, ethereal glow begins in center of screen. CrowdWisdomTrading logo fades in gently with soft white light. scenes.visual: Slow zoom into CrowdWisdomTrading interface. Clean, uncluttered dashboard fills screen. One hand enters frame — calm, deliberate movements. Clicking on organized sections. The interface breathes with space and clarity. Soft ambient music continues.
scenes.voiceover: CrowdWisdomTrading filters the noise and delivers distilled market intelligence. One clear view. No more scrolling. No more second-guessing.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of trader leaning back in ergonomic chair with relaxed posture. Hands folded calmly over stomach. Looking at screen with confident, focused expression. storyboards.title: The Beginners' Shortcut

Friendly host (mid-30s, approachable appearance) sitting on a sleek chair, directly addressing camera with warm smile. Each section has beginner-friendly labels and tooltips. Host walks through dashboard with simple gestures. Screenshots of real trader dashboards visible in soft focus behind. Icons are friendly and non-intimidating.
scenes.voiceover: We organize market intelligence in a way that's easy to understand, easy to follow, and easy to build upon. No jargon. No hype. Just clear, structured insight.
scenes.text_overlay: Easy to understand • Easy to follow • Easy to build on

scenes.visual: Animation of a vertical skill tree or progress path. Root node: 'Basics' with a small sprout icon. Second level: 'Reading Charts' with sapling icon. scenes.visual: Cinematic establishing shot through rain-streaked window of city skyline at dusk. Golden hour light fading to deep blue. Camera slowly pushes through window to reveal trader alone at desk, illuminated only by monitor glow. Face shows uncertainty and doubt. Phone on desk displays a notification — 'BUY Signal from @TradingGuru'. Trader looks at phone, then at charts, uncertain. Shadow reflections dance across face. Atmospheric, slightly melancholic piano music begins softly.
scenes.voiceover: It's late. You're alone with your charts. That signal you followed... you're not sure why you took it. You trust the source, but you don't trust yourself.

scenes.visual: Close-up of trader's hands on desk, fingers tapping nervously. Cut to face looking upward, searching. Monitor reflects multiple windows: TradingView charts, Telegram groups, news sites, YouTube tutorials. Each reflection creates ghostly overlay on trader's face. Cut to shadow of trader alone, stretched long across the wall. The weight of trading solo, without understanding, is palpable. Music deepens with subtle tension.
scenes.voiceover: You're following strategies. You're watching the news. You're in Telegram groups. But something's still missing.

scenes.visual: Black screen. Bold white text fades in, centered. Camera is completely still — the silence is powerful. Music pauses. After a beat, text glows slightly. The question hangs in the air. Simple, dramatic typography. Plenty of negative space. The moment is introspective.
scenes.voiceover: What are you missing?

scenes.visual: Medium shot of trader focusing on CrowdWisdomTrading dashboard. Camera slowly moves closer. Close-up of eyes as understanding dawns — pupils dilate slightly, eyebrows lift.
